statements.t: We expect continued revenue growth in this channel as we invest in increasing brand awareness, executing effective in-store promotions, launching new products, and expanding distribution in the FDM market.

• DTC channel revenue has grown as we continue to optimize customer acquisition, enhance retention, and provide our customers with a personalized and engaging shopping experience through targeted content and tailored product offerings on our website.
During the second quarter of 2025, we implemented the Operational Improvement Plan to reduce costs and improve the efficiency of certain company-wide functions.
We estimate that the costs savings as a result of this plan will exceed $12.7 million on an annualized run rate basis.

During the third quarter of 2026, management committed to Project Core, a multi-year strategic initiative intended to strengthen our core coffee business, improve profitability, simplify our operations and reduce the capital intensity of our business.

As part of Project Core, we plan to close 12 company-operated Outposts by the end of the first quarter of 2027, and during the third quarter of 2026 we modified leases for eight operating locations to substantially shorten their remaining terms.

The lease modification fees which have not yet been paid are included in operating lease liabilities as of September 30, 2026 and are expected to be paid over the next twelve months using cash on hand and borrowings under our ABL Facility.
We are not able to reasonably estimate the total costs of Project Core because the remaining actions have not yet been finalized.
We expect the Outpost closures to reduce Outpost channel revenue and related operating costs.

On October 29, 2026, subsequent to the end of the third quarter of 2026, we signed an agreement to sell the Manchester Plant to Cascade Coffee, LLC, a longstanding manufacturing partner, for $17.0 million, consisting of $10.0 million in cash and a $7.0 million note receivable. $8.6 million of the cash proceeds will be used to repay the term loan in accordance with our credit agreement.
We intend to continue to refine and develop our brand strategy utilizing reach-based formats such as streaming advertising and other select marketing channels.
In addition, we will leverage our social media presence and employ targeted digital advertising to expand the reach of our brand.
We believe that consistently acquiring and retaining customers at a reasonable cost will be a key driver of our future performance.
Our pace of growth will be partially affected by the timing and scale of new product launches.

Our ability to successfully execute Project Core, a multi-year initiative to strengthen our core coffee business, improve profitability, simplify our operations and reduce the capital intensity of our business, will be an important factor in our future performance (see “Recent Developments”).
These initiatives may result in additional costs or operational disruption, and we may not realize the anticipated benefits within the expected time frame or at all.

We currently expect to fund our material capital requirements with borrowings from our credit facilities, but we may also seek additional debt or equity financing.

statements.t: We also launched Project Core, our multi-year initiative to sharpen our focus on our core coffee business and brand, improve profitability and earnings quality, simplify our operations, and reduce the capital intensity of our business.
“We also made meaningful progress on Project Core.
We initiated plans to close 12 company-operated Outposts, modified eight leases for locations we no longer intend to develop, and completed the divestiture of a non-core DTC brand.

These actions mark a significant step toward a more asset-light operating model, which we expect will support franchise-led retail growth, lower capital requirements, and create a more efficient cost structure.

We are reaffirming our full-year 2026 outlook of at least 8% revenue growth and at least 35% Adjusted EBITDA growth, even after incorporating the expected revenue impact of the brand divestiture and Outpost closures.”
The Company is reaffirming its full-year 2026 guidance based on current market conditions, including commodity costs and planned growth investments.

The Company’s reaffirmed 2026 outlook incorporates an expected fourth-quarter revenue headwind of approximately $3 million associated with the divestiture of a non-core DTC brand and planned Outpost closures.
A live webcast of the call will be available on the Investor Relations page of the Company’s website at ir.blackriflecoffee.com.
Adjusted EBITDA is also a key metric used internally by our management to evaluate performance and develop internal budgets and forecasts.
